title: Prove sharp boundary-rank endpoint horizon (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove a sharp rank-sensitive positive-width horizon for complete fixed finite-memory endpoints `F T_w B`. Claim type: scoped written mathematical proof with exact finite corroboration. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas.

```diff
 positive seed rank r, transfer dimension D, right-boundary rank b>0
- sufficient horizon D-r+1
+ sufficient horizon max(1,D-r-b+2)
```

If either r or b is zero, every positive-width residual is zero. The new bound is attained for every admissible triple D,r,b over every field by an explicit zero/one cyclic construction. At D=8,r=2,b=3 the first discrepancy is exactly five, so a horizon of four fails. The prior sufficient bound is seven.

The new step confines passing reachable rows to the right-boundary kernel of dimension D-b. Credit zxv / [PR5441](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5441), head `11fedb46fa199283f78282187c10aea432d8b0bb`, for the complete physical-column model, earlier seed-rank criterion and positive-width/full-return convention. Weighted-automata reachability and rank-nullity are classical. Its retained Kiefer/Tzeng/Crosswhite-Bacon, independent/inverse-register, native and compiler lineage keeps its credit. No predecessor scientific checker is imported or replayed, and no general literature-priority claim is made.

Only `research/boundary-rank-horizon/` is added. The independently posed question and changed card scope are recorded in the [advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19375593). Discovery stopped at this first verified step.

## Evidence

- The written proof covers every field and finite dimension, arbitrary noncommuting fixed transitions, rectangular boundaries and complete roles.
- Every binary one-symbol transition table in dimensions 1..3 and every ordered two-symbol table in dimensions 1..2 is paired with every left/right boundary subspace. The 137,896 normalized contracts yield 288,662 literal endpoint-block observations. These counts do not enumerate all literal rectangular boundary matrices.
- All 650 positive rank triples through D=12 attain the predicted first width. Nine invalid domains reject; five semantic controls cover the off-by-one bound, mixed words, returned-role omission and zero dimension. Seed-rank row-XOR arithmetic and the word oracle's column-dot arithmetic are separate.
- CPython 3.12.15, macOS 27.0.1 arm64, standard library only. Warning-strict normal and optimized direct replays pass with identical complete generated hash-bound receipts, in 0.393 s and 0.396 s. The registered pair and metadata checks pass in 1.106 s total. These are check durations, not speedup claims. Functions are at most 28 lines; AST parsing and staged whitespace checks pass.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight passes for `00798d2af754c4123a80666e513b8f7585d5b617`, covering seven files and canonical-base ancestry. Official package export and declared-input integrity pass. The optimized `-I -S` replay from a read-only export with empty PATH agrees byte for byte and leaves all eight export files and modes unchanged.

From the repository root, exact local reproduction commands are:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/boundary-rank-horizon/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/boundary-rank-horizon/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/boundary-rank-horizon
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/boundary-rank-horizon --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 path can replace the displayed interpreter. Expected markers are `PASS_BOUNDARY_RANK_HORIZON`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The horizon requires exact equality, fixed tables and boundaries across widths, every physical word, and every independent input/output and dirty-return role. It is not a numerical-tolerance criterion. It does not extract a table, minimize its dimension or improve physical word enumeration at a fixed width. The all-field claim rests on the written proof; finite corroboration uses F2.

No actual selected provider or consumer, physical/native realization, paid invoice, restoration outside the represented endpoint, precision/tape/stock/compiler or analytic admission is supplied. All five selected assumptions remain. No new kappa or selected-frontier change. Selected cold replay, predecessor suites, Lean, Docker, independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unrun or unclaimed.

## Open next questions

Can one actual complete provider/consumer residual exhibit b>1 and a useful horizon reduction after every return is included? Extract its fixed table, compute both ranks and compare the horizons. Actual source-table extraction and complete physical costs are the blockers. This follow-up is unclaimed.

## Related open work

The open PR inventory was refreshed after CI, including every open PR from this account created since the CLAIM. No additional PR studying this exact horizon was found.

- [PR6622](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6622) studies uniform operator error for triangular complex transfer tables with a contracting transient block. This result concerns exact equality horizons over arbitrary fields and fixed transitions; it neither compares numerical error constants nor replays that work.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks, `plan` and `replay (research/boundary-rank-horizon)`, passed for head `00798d2af754c4123a80666e513b8f7585d5b617` in [run 41651304249](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41651304249). The completed checks were read once; run metadata independently confirms that exact head and successful conclusion. Local normal/optimized, registered replay, committed-byte/source-history and portable export checks also passed. CI supplies automated replay evidence, not independent human or proof-kernel acceptance of the all-field written proof.

## Merge danger

Reversible package-only addition. Existing suppliers, shared execution code and selected records are unchanged.
